verdict.rationale: WezTerm's docs cover the whole story: built-in splits and panes with horizontal/vertical split and pane-navigation keybindings, native tabs, and local multiplexing "similar to those in tmux or screen." The CLI can also manipulate tabs and panes. Independent hands-on reports corroborate this, including users who completely replaced tmux with WezTerm and praised its fast pane splitting and resizing and its reconnectable sessions with panes and tabs.
